name: multi-device-splay
title: Multi Device Splay
description: Multi-device splay: a monitor, a tablet and a phone fan out around one product, each showing a dark brand skeleton of the same app suited to its form factor, with one brand-red accent. In a portrait field (vertical reel) the fan restacks: monitor on top, tablet and phone side by side below; in a landscape field the three fan out in a row.
